title: Tech-facilitated sexual exploitation and abuse
discussion_signal: UNICEF presents technology-facilitated abuse as a systemic child-protection problem. A visible reaction rejects placing responsibility on children to spot danger and argues that platforms must match their influence with equally powerful safety systems, supporting a redesign/accountability reading alongside exit concerns.
linked_research_question: When digital platforms expose children to abuse, how do families and institutions weigh exit, safety redesign, accountability, and participation?
limits: Institutional post and one self-selected reaction
Reported cross-country figure is not independently analyzed here
The discussion does not identify which platform interventions work
